knowledge:
- key_parameters: object=Vector of chromosome names/factors ;; starts=Vector of genomic positions (must be sorted) ;; group=Logical or binary vector indicating the group of each site ;; kvals=Integer vector of window widths in terms of number of sites (e.g., 15L:30L) ;; nperm=Number of permutations for estimating false discoveries (e.g., 100L) ;; cutpt.tail.expr=Expression evaluated to set critical values (defaults to critVal.target(k, n, target=5, posdiff=x)) ;; cutpt.filter.expr=Expression evaluated to filter out wide windows (defaults to median width)
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation, but references Berry et al. (2014) for scan statistics details.
- when_to_use: Use when comparing the spatial distribution of genomic sites (e.g., viral integration sites) between two groups to find regions of localized enrichment in one group relative to the other.
- pitfalls: Input genomic positions must be ordered from lowest to highest within each chromosome before running the analysis. Failing to apply appropriate filtering (or using non-specific filters) can significantly impact statistical power and the number of false discoveries.

workflows.name: differential_clustering_analysis
workflows.intent: Detect and analyze genomic regions with differential clustering of integration sites between two groups.
input: exptData.txt (A tab-delimited text file containing columns for chromosome, position, and group indicator)
workflows.stages: 1. Read genomic site data from a file ;; 2. Run the differential clustering analysis using gRxCluster ;; 3. Summarize the discovered clusters and false discovery rate using gRxSummary ;; 4. Plot the critical regions using gRxPlot ;; 5. (Optional) Customize critical regions and filters to optimize discovery power
workflows.code:
df <- read.table("exptData.txt", header=TRUE)

require(geneRxCluster,quietly=TRUE)
null.results <-
    gRxCluster(df$chromo,df$pos,df$grp,15L:30L,nperm=100L)

gRxSummary( null.results )

gRxPlot(alt.results,method="criticalRegions")

generous.target.expr <-
    quote(critVal.target(k,n, target=20, posdiff=x))
generous.results <-
    gRxCluster(df3$chromo,df3$pos,df3$grp,
	       15L:30L,nperm=100L,
	       cutpt.tail.expr=generous.target.expr)
gRxSummary(generous.results)

no.filter.expr <- quote(rep(Inf,ncol(x)))
no.filter.results <-
    gRxCluster(df3$chromo,df3$pos,df3$grp,15L:30L,nperm=100L,
	       cutpt.filter.expr=no.filter.expr)
gRxSummary(no.filter.results)

hard.filter.expr <-
    quote(apply(x,2,quantile, 0.15, na.rm=TRUE))
hard.filter.results <-
    gRxCluster(df3$chromo,df3$pos,df3$grp,15L:30L,
	       nperm=100L,
	       cutpt.filter.expr=hard.filter.expr)
gRxSummary(hard.filter.results)
